header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Calc Studio
header.desc: Open-source budgeting and cost estimation tool for construction. From cost estimates to final accounts, with direct connections to STABU/RAW, IFCX and AI.

mcp.title: AI-powered estimation via MCP
mcp.desc: Open Calc Studio is fully accessible via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This means AI assistants like Claude can directly create budgets, add items, recalculate and export — without manual input.
mcp.item1: Create and manage budgets from Claude Code or other AI tools
mcp.item2: Automatically extract quantities from IFC/IFCX models
mcp.item3: Look up reference projects for realistic unit prices
mcp.item4: Export to PDF and IFCX directly from the AI workflow

why.title: Why Open Calc Studio?
why.desc1: Cost estimates and budgets are essential for every construction project. Existing estimation software costs thousands of euros per license and locks you into proprietary formats. Open Calc Studio offers a fully open-source alternative that is just as powerful.
why.desc2: With direct connections to STABU/RAW standards, IFCX models for automatic quantities, and AI integration via MCP, Open Calc Studio is built for the future of AEC cost estimation.

stabu.title: STABU/RAW integration
stabu.desc: Full support for STABU and RAW standards for standardized specifications and cost estimates according to Dutch norms.

ifcx.title: IFCX quantities
ifcx.desc: Automatically extract quantities from IFCX models. Link budget items directly to model elements for accurate calculations.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.desc: Fully accessible via Model Context Protocol. AI assistants can create, edit and export budgets.

extensions.title: Extension system
extensions.desc: Extensible via an extension catalog. Add industry-specific calculation methods, templates and integrations.

chapters.title: Chapters & sections
chapters.desc: Organize budgets into chapters, sections and budget items. Flexible hierarchy with automatic numbering.

reference.title: Reference projects
reference.desc: Look up unit prices from reference projects. Build a reusable database of prices and key figures.

export.title: PDF & IFCX export
export.desc: Export budgets as professional PDF reports or as IFCX data for exchange with other tools in the ecosystem.

staart.title: Overhead costs
staart.desc: Configurable overhead costs: general site costs, profit & risk, CAR insurance and other surcharges automatically calculated.

recalc.title: Recalculation
recalc.desc: One-click recalculation of the entire budget. All subtotals, VAT and overhead costs are automatically updated.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: Built with TypeScript and Rust via Tauri 2. Runs as a desktop application on Windows, macOS and Linux, and as a web application in the browser. Includes MCP Server for AI integration and extension system for customization.
